correctness.rationale: Both the frozen mathematics and revised uniqueness theorem are correct. In the revised proof the stationary pullback is bounded; the irreducible modulator and contraction give uniqueness. Applying the generator also to Y^j gives m_j=H_(j-1). The other generator equations give H_(j-1)=(j-1)R_(j-2)/(j-1+a) and R_j/m_j=(j+c)/(j+a+c), including the j=0 initial ratio, producing all three forward formulas. Solving the variance gives exactly 0<a<A_s=(1-s)/s and c=as(1+a)/(1-s(1+a)). For d=2,4 write F_d as in the revised proof. For quadratics with coefficients u_2,u_1,u_0 and w_2,w_1,w_0, the numerator cross-difference after dividing by x-y is (u_2w_1-u_1w_2)xy+(u_2w_0-u_0w_2)(x+y)+(u_1w_0-u_0w_1). Inserting the F_d coefficients and dividing by -d gives the two symmetric equations in the revision. Their determinant factors as -8s²(s-1), and substituting xy=A_s²/2, x+y=3A_s/2 satisfies both. One root is always A_s, which forces infinite c and is inadmissible, proving global injectivity and the stated constructive recovery. For the frozen fold, specializing the d=2 identity at x=y gives the derivative polynomial with endpoint signs of opposite sign and degree at most two; there is exactly one simple turning point even at s=3/5 when the polynomial is linear. Endpoint values 1/3 and s/(1+2s) yield the frozen count; the latter endpoint rate is excluded although its q-value is attained on the other branch. Exact substitution verifies the revised illustration: both q values are 29/120 at s=1/2, while the normalized sixth ratios are 37/230 and 263/1634, giving the stated different sixth moments.
residual_risks: Exact stationary moments and separately known trap relaxation and active speed are required; the argument gives no uniform stable inverse or result at zero/infinite rates or under diffusion.

value.rationale: The revised question is motivated directly by the known model's exact and genuine ambiguity from two natural stationary observables: does one more even moment separate all rate pairs or merely some? The repaired theorem guarantees separation for every compatible observation and supplies a low-degree reconstruction, rather than claiming an arbitrary forward calculation or rebranding the already established fold. In the sequence of even moments beginning at the variance, two are insufficient and three suffice on the finite positive domain.
residual_risks: No minimum claim for arbitrary nonconsecutive moment choices, and no statistical or numerical-conditioning guarantee.
